name: Millet (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Millet (Panicum miliaceum) [Cereals and cereal products] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DTU, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central FDC 169702 (Millet, raw) - macros, amino acids, fatty acids, minerals, vitamins
Subramanian & Jambunathan 1981, J Food Sci doi:10.1111/j.1365-2621.1981.tb04232.x - pearl millet free sugars
FAO T0818E - Sorghum and millets in human nutrition (sugar profile)
Ravindran 1991, Food Chem doi:10.1016/0308-8146(91)90088-8 - phytate & oxalate in millets
Review PMC3982016 - pearl millet phytate content
Peshuk et al. 2020, BIO Web Conf doi:10.1051/bioconf/20201700039 - organic acids in millet by capillary electrophoresis
provenance.curation_notes: Millet is a starch-dominated cereal: ~62 g/100g starch is by far the dominant carbon/energy source, with only ~1.7-2 g/100g free sugars (chiefly sucrose, then raffinose, minor glucose/fructose; maltose effectively absent unless malted). The most consequential omissions filled in were the organic acids - phytic acid (~550 mg/100g, the grain's main organic acid and P/inositol store) and low oxalate (~20 mg/100g) - plus niacin and two missing amino acids. Removed FooDB noise: MK-4 vitamin K2, oxype
curation_added: specific free sugars: sucrose, raffinose, D-glucose, D-fructose with amounts
organic acids: phytic acid, oxalic acid (quantified); citric/fumaric/succinic (present, unquantified)
L-phenylalanine, L-valine (amino acids missing from current list)
dietary fiber, total protein, total fat, class fatty-acid totals

curation_removed.name: Menatetrenone
curation_removed.reason: Menaquinone-4 (vitamin K2 MK-4) is an animal/bacterial form; implausible in a plant grain, which carries only phylloquinone (K1). FooDB predicted noise

curation_removed.name: (R)-Oxypeucedanin
curation_removed.reason: Furanocoumarin characteristic of Apiaceae/Rutaceae (parsnip, citrus); biologically implausible in millet grain. FooDB predicted/mis-mapped

curation_removed.name: epsilon-Polylysine
curation_removed.reason: Microbial fermentation polymer (Streptomyces product used as preservative), not a native grain metabolite

curation_removed.name: (E)-2-Phenyl-2-butenal
curation_removed.reason: Trace Strecker-degradation flavor aldehyde, not a growth nutrient; negligible mass

curation_removed.name: (±)-erythro-Isoleucine
curation_removed.reason: Non-physiological diastereomer / duplicate of L-isoleucine already listed; FooDB artifact

curation_removed.name: d-Tocopherol
curation_removed.reason: Redundant with tocopherol vitamin E already captured (alpha/gamma); delta-tocopherol folds into total vitamin E, keep as uncovered not a separate growth nutrient

curation_removed.name: Co2+ / CO2 / H2O / H+ / O2 / Nitrogen / Ammonium
curation_removed.reason: Generic BiGG exchange/background species, not food-composition nutrients; supplied by the medium framework, not the millet matrix

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all divides components by (components + unresolved ingredients). It counts pipeline-derived components as covered, so it is not a measure of how much of the source's own ingredient list was captured. pct_covered_source divides source-stated components by (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components), which is that measure. Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
